constraints.name: graph_is_undirected_tree
constraints.description: The rooms and corridors form an undirected tree.

constraints.name: vlad_goal_leaf_except_root
constraints.description: Vlad wins by reaching a leaf room (room other than 1 with exactly one incident corridor).

constraints.name: friend_count_less_than_room_count
constraints.description: The number of friends k is strictly less than the number of rooms n.

constraints.name: synchronous_unit_movement
constraints.description: Each time unit, every participant may move along at most one corridor; all move simultaneously; staying in place is allowed.

constraints.name: room_unlimited_capacity
constraints.description: Each room can contain all participants at the same time.

constraints.name: capture_before_leaf
constraints.description: Friends win if they meet Vlad in any room or corridor before he reaches his target leaf.

constraints.name: subset_guarantee_capture
constraints.description: A subset of friends can catch Vlad only if they can always catch him regardless of Vlad's moving strategy.

constraints.name: minimize_friend_subset
constraints.description: Determine the minimum size of a subset of friends that can guarantee catching Vlad; if no such subset exists, output -1.
